def stat_reference(ctx: DeviceContext) raises:
    comptime kern = identical_gemm_int8_mma_kernel
    var f = ctx.compile_function[kern, dump_asm=Path("/tmp/lowbit-mma-speed-ptx/dumps/reference.ptx")]()
    print(
        "PTX_PROBE label=reference",
        " regs=", f.get_attribute(Attribute.NUM_REGS),
        " local=", f.get_attribute(Attribute.LOCAL_SIZE_BYTES),
        " shared=", f.get_attribute(Attribute.SHARED_SIZE_BYTES),
        sep="",
    )

def main() raises:
    var ctx = DeviceContext()
    try:
        stat_reference(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=reference error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_direct_reference_loads(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=direct_reference_loads error=", e, sep="")

        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=probe_loads_hoisted error=", e, sep="")

        stat_staged_w16_b32_k32_l4(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=staged_w16_b32_k32_l4 error=", e, sep="")

        stat_staged_w64_b128_k32_l4(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=staged_w64_b128_k32_l4 error=", e, sep="")

        stat_staged_w64_b128_k64_l16(ctx)

        stat_staged_w32_b64_k64_l16(ctx)
